ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager sure that today would be terrible finds that nothing bad has happened by late afternoon.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) woke up absolutely certain that today was going to be terrible. (subject.He/She) slept badly, stubbed a toe on the doorway, and it looked like rain. (subject.He/She) has spent the whole morning braced for disaster. It is now late afternoon, and nothing bad has happened at all.

choices.label: Admit It Was a Good Day

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) eyes every coconut tree suspiciously. (subject.He/She) checks the sky. (subject.He/She) checks the sky again. The sun sets on a perfectly pleasant day. "It's going to get me tomorrow," (subject) mutters. It doesn't. Tomorrow is fine too.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: At dinner, (subject) announces, rather grudgingly, "Today was... actually quite nice." (friend) looks up in surprise. "You said it would be terrible." "I know," says (subject). "I was wrong. Don't get used to it."
